logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Vertical bar chart for the WO-01 pump-selection report: four bars for the qualified modules P1, P2, P3 and P4, bar height equal to measured energy in kWh per common acceptance run (56, 12, 52, 58). Each module's raw defect count is printed beneath its ID (4, 1, 3, 0), and quality indices (84, 97, 80, 81) appear in a footnote with the qualification gates (quality floor 80, defect ceiling 5). P4 is highlighted in a distinct green as the only zero-defect module, with a callout box noting its +46 kWh energy premium versus P2, the lowest-energy module. Gridlines every 10 kWh, y-axis titled "kWh per acceptance run", neutral sans-serif labels, no decorative elements.
